study_type_evidence.quote: We performed the pulmonary absorption studies of plain fasudil and liposomal formulations in control (no-PAH) and PAH-afflicted adult male SD rats (250-300 g)
we used an IPRL system (Hugo Sachs Elektronik, Harvard Apparatus GmbH ...). We surgically removed the lungs from control and PAH rats
When PACs were treated with fasudil-in-CAR-liposomes versus fasudil-in-no-CAR-liposomes, drug uptake was greater from CAR-liposomes

in_vivo_species.strain_sex_age: adult male Sprague Dawley, 250-300 g (PK); 200-225 g for PAH model induction

ex_vivo_detail: Isolated perfused rat lung (IPRL) from sham and PAH rats, dosed via pulmonary artery or trachea.
in_vitro_detail: Fasudil uptake by pulmonary arterial cells from control and PAH rats.

agents.sequence_source: The CAR peptide sequence is not printed in the body; PEPlife2 gives CARSKNKDC. The peptide is the liposome's targeting ligand, not the measured analyte.
agents.dose_route_quote: Anesthetized control and PAH rats, that are divided into 14 groups (7 control rats plus 7 PAH rats; n = 3), received 3 mg/kg fasudil
agents.half_life_matrix: rat plasma - FASUDIL concentration, not peptide concentration
agents.pk_quote: Collecting blood samples, via tail-vein milking ... we separated the plasma ... and quantified fasudil in the plasma using the above LC-MS/MS method.

concentration_time_figure.caption_quote: In both sham and PAH animals, IV administration of plain fasudil or different formulations led to a quick rise (Table 4) followed by a rapid decline in drug plasma concentration (Figure 12A,B).

notes: THE MEASURED ANALYTE IS NOT THE PEPTIDE. All four PEPlife2 values verified against the 'fasudil in CAR-liposome' row of Table 4 (IV sham 0.7, IV PAH 1.1, IT sham 12.9, IT PAH 16.1 h), but every one is the plasma half-life of FASUDIL, a small-molecule Rho-kinase inhibitor. The CAR peptide (CARSKNKDC) is a heparan-sulphate-targeting ligand conjugated to the liposome surface; its own concentration is never measured. The paper attributes the extended half-life to liposome accumulation, slow drug release and absorption-controlled elimination, not to any property of the peptide - and the 18-fold spread between the IV and IT values for the identical peptide shows the label is set by the route and formulation, not the sequence. These four records (PEPlife2 IDs 5362-5365) have been excluded via CURATED_NOT_A_HALF_LIFE, because in a sequence-to-half-life training set they would assert that CARSKNKDC has a 16 h half-life.
